titulo_es: An integrated evaluation · Final reading evaluation B2

texto: In the final evaluation, it aligns the reading to the task. It checks who states each thing, what evidence it offers and what limits it recognizes; it distinguishes a reasonable inference from a conclusion that exceeds the text.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
